route: playwright.chromium headless (Python 3.11), http://127.0.0.1:8031/live-copy rendered DOM; oracle = served JSON API + on-disk snapshot; no engine import; read-only

rows.feature: Live Copy Status cards: MASTER REAL ORDERS
rows.expected: Shows live_top_status.master_real_orders as master real order switch (provenance LIVE_SERVICE_STATE; execution truth: YES).
rows.probe: Rendered DOM #lcTruthStatus .lc-stat cards (probe2/p4) + page-wide text scan for /MASTER REAL/i (probe3 any_master_text) + served /api/live-copy-summary.live_top_status.master_real_orders
rows.basis: The rendered status strip contains exactly 8 cards: HEALTH, LEADER FEED, FOLLOWER ACCOUNT READ, WALLETS, LAST SEND, LAST FILL, LAST REJECT, LAST LATENCY WARNING. There is NO MASTER REAL ORDERS card; page-wide leaf scan for /MASTER REAL/i returned 0 hits. The API DOES expose live_top_status.master_real_orders="OFF", but the value is not rendered anywhere in the panel. Chain breaks at the render step.

rows.feature: Live Copy Status cards: Active/subscribed wallets
rows.expected: Shows live_top_status.active_wallets/subscribed_wallets as active wallet count / subscribed count.
rows.probe: DOM .lc-stat WALLETS card value (probe2/p4) vs /api/live-copy-summary live_top_status.{active_wallets,subscribed_wallets,live_wallets}; token scan for active_wallets/subscribed_wallets/ACTIVE/SUBSCRIBED
rows.basis: Rendered WALLETS card value = "10 live / 10 followed"; API active_wallets=10, subscribed_wallets=10, live_wallets=10 -> counts MATCH. However there is no discrete "active_wallets"/"subscribed_wallets" element as the register names it; token scan for active_wallets/subscribed_wallets = false and ACTIVE/SUBSCRIBED = 0. Data fidelity holds; the named element does not exist. No negative-path (stale/unavailable) proof captured.

rows.feature: Live Copy Status cards: Last send
rows.expected: Shows live_top_status.last_send as latest send_attempt row (provenance ENGINE_TRUTH).
rows.probe: DOM .lc-stat LAST SEND card (probe2/p4) vs /api/live-copy-summary.live_top_status.last_send at same instant
rows.basis: LAST SEND card present and renders a live last_send entry (coin + status): probe4 DOM "BANANA pending_send" at dom_ms=1792196089946, API last_send coin=CAKE status=pending_send created_at_ms=1792196088106. Field present, status (pending_send) matches; the coin differs only because last_send advances every ~1-3s and the DOM/API reads are 3.5s apart (cross-process clock skew on a sub-second-advancing field; exact-value atomicity not achievable).

rows.feature: Live Copy Status cards: Last latency warning
rows.expected: Shows live_top_status.last_latency_warning as latest SEND_LATENCY_WARN reconciliation row.
rows.probe: DOM .lc-stat LAST LATENCY WARNING card (probe2/p4) vs /api/live-copy-summary.live_top_status.last_latency_warning
rows.basis: LAST LATENCY WARNING card present and renders a full SEND_LATENCY_WARN row. probe4 DOM: "severity=WARN; classification=SLOW_EXCHANGE_CALL; wallet=0x31ca... coin=POPCAT intent_id=... delay_ms=1793 largest_component=exchange_call_ms:1063"; API last_latency_warning status=SLOW_SEND_PATH notes="severity=CRITICAL; classification=SLOW_EXCHANGE_CALL; wallet=0x0104... coin=BANANA ...". Shape matches exactly (severity/classification/wallet/coin/delay/largest_component); values differ only by the same sub-second field-advance skew.

rows.expected: Shows selected wallet current_exposure points from live_leader_performance[wallet].exposure_series as MANUAL_LEDGER.
rows.probe: Page-wide svg enumeration + graph/chart/exposure id scan + wallet-row click to reveal detail (probe3); /api/live-copy-summary.live_leader_performance[wallet].exposure_series
rows.basis: Exactly ONE svg exists page-wide (#lcEquityChart, the ACCOUNT equity graph). There is NO per-wallet / selected-wallet exposure graph element: after clicking a wallet row (lcWalletModal), the svg set is unchanged (still only lcEquityChart). The data IS present in the API (live_leader_performance[wallet].exposure_series is a list for every wallet) but it is not plotted. Chain breaks at the render step.
